description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to learn the context-scope-tags protocol. 2. Agent parses raw_messages.json and for each message: detects tags only at the very start of the message (msg_009 has tags mid-message → must be treated as no-tag/default), resolves long-form aliases ([Isolated Context:], [Global Context OK], [No Memory], [Remember]) identically to their short forms, applies the 'last-tag-wins' conflict rule for [ISO]+[GLOBAL] (msg_004 → GLOBAL wins), [REM]+[NOMEM] (msg_005 → NOMEM wins), [NOMEM]+[REM] (msg_011 → REM wins), notes the conflict in each affected decision, emits a reuse callout whenever [GLOBAL] is active (msgs 002, 004, 008, 012), applies default conservative no-cross-topic behavior when no valid tags are present (msgs 006, 009). 3. Outputs routing_decisions.json with all 12 decisions keyed by message ID, each containing at minimum: scope_mode, memory_intent, detected tags in order, conflict resolution notes, and reuse callout where applicable.
